featureCatalog.file_scope: Access boundaries for the workspace and protected file paths.
featureCatalog.approval: Explicit approval required for operations such as overwriting an existing file.
featureCatalog.execution_grant: A one-time permission consumed before an allowed executor starts.
featureCatalog.topic_assignment: Trusted topic assignment from configuration, or an embedding candidate after review; the source is identified with each event.
featureCatalog.embeddings: Semantic topic check using the configured embedding model; a check alone does not mean a topic was detected.
featureCatalog.guardian: Session supervisor that can return violation, uncertainty, or no identified violation.
featureCatalog.session_state: Session lifecycle and review state; some events are informational.
featureCatalog.network_scope: HTTP request intent and its policy check.
featureCatalog.budgets: None of the selected events shows a budget decision.
featureCatalog.threat_feed: None of the selected events shows a threat-feed match.
featureCatalog.semantic_review: None of the selected events shows a Jev semantic decision.
featureCatalog.output_control: Control over whether a model call or response is blocked or released.
featureCatalog.policy_publication: None of the selected events shows a policy publication.
